QF.id: XVI Clearing, Settlement and Risk Management_59

answer.text: Periodic inspection of member premises, checking compliance with regulatory guidelines and controls

explanation.text: The Logic: Offline surveillance consists of inspections, investigations, reviews and examinations carried out to verify member compliance with exchange byelaws, regulations, guidelines and controls. This includes physical inspections and checks on margin reporting and client-level segregation. The Trap: Real-time monitoring is online surveillance, not offline. Publishing market reports and conducting annual shareholder meetings are unrelated exchange functions. Note: Distributor/cross-exam coaching labels removed; explanation rewritten with neutral compliance wording.
